decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through-glass vias build directly on Plan Optik's core competence in structured glass wafers, so the firm can interpret customer feedback and keep refining the product.
Carrier wafers are a simple extension of the firm's established glass wafer processing with low complexity and steady demand, making them easy to sustain.
The Cu-interposer combines the firm's glass expertise with metallization knowledge gained through its own R&D and makes it a strategic packaging technology worth continuing to learn from.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand reuses existing standard glass and quartz wafer capabilities and opens a low-cost sales channel with little need for new knowledge.

Glass-based circuit boards move further from the firm's core wafer knowledge into PCB markets where it has less related knowledge, but they share the via and metallization know-how, so the firm will keep them while learning from early results.
